svg.text: BALANCED TERNARY MULTIPLY-ADD / X + A*B + Cin = Sum + 3*Cout
Combinational 1-trit slice: mul -> full_adder. No state, accumulator, or mode MUX.
B=+5 V: X+A+Cin (ADD/FA); B=-5 V: X-A+Cin (SUB).
Levels -5/0/+5 V encode -1/0/+1. Power: VDD=+5 V, VMID=0 V, VSS=-5 V.
MUL: 14 MOS + 8 RR. FA: 98 MOS + 32 RR. Three extra INV: 6 MOS + 6 RR. Total: 118 MOS + 46 RR.
AND=min(A,B); OR=max(A,B), isolated/restored through two INV stages. 11 pins.
All RR: W=2.8 um, L=30 um. Target load: >=1 Mohm || 10 pF, 1 us settling.
10 V rail span is a user-accepted voltage-rating exception; not a lifetime qualification.
